introduction.title: Talent Protocol is your onchain resume. A user-friendly smart wallet that represents your professional reputation onchain.

titleGroup: Talent Protocol brings professional reputation onchain to make incredible builders more visible on the new age internet.

props.text: You are what you use as your mugshot—that’s the concept behind Talent Protocol's identity, centered on individual personas. The "tp" connection hints at an ASCII-style figure, with the idea to offer a diverse range of emoticons, allowing users to build their own avatar to reflect their online identity. Alongside each person’s $token, users can choose their ID color palette and customize an icon that shifts to represent their face. Imagine a future LinkedIn profile where your photo, token, and personal icon branding seamlessly coexist with a dash of motion graphics to keep it interesting.
props.title: Rebranding

props.text:
The design system uses interconnected shapes to create a seamless flow and sense of connection throughout the interface. These shapes help organize the content intuitively, guiding users smoothly from one section to the next without feeling overwhelming. The rounded forms give the design a friendly, approachable feel while maintaining structure, clarity, and a unique touch with the color palettes and $tokenization.

Balancing the personal with the professional, the system integrates key elements like the user’s name, token symbol, and photo into a cohesive layout. It's simple yet effective, emphasizing the user's personal identity while also reinforcing the Talent Protocol brand.

Motion graphics further elevate the experience, highlighting each persona's hierarchy and tone of voice. Whether you're a goth, a crypto enthusiast, or an entrepreneur, the system adapts to any identity, making it versatile and user-centric.
